# Ivan de Murard, Product Builder

## Identity

Ivan de Murard is a product builder based in Paris, France. He has five years of product management experience across start-ups, scale-ups and large groups, plus two years as co-founder and product lead of Sonor, a B2G SaaS for urban noise mapping. He designs from operational experience, ships with AI, and keeps the human at the center.

Contact: ivandemurard@gmail.com. Booking: https://cal.com/ivandemurard/30min. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ivandemurard/. GitHub: https://github.com/IvandeMurard.

## Convictions

1. Human interactions first. Technology should give time back to people, not pull them deeper into screens. The best automation is the one that lets a host be more present.
2. Real business value. Reducing operational costs, freeing capacity, sharpening decisions. Every product has to move a number that matters to the business.
3. Full-stack 0 to 1 craft. From insight to shipped product, bridging digital interfaces and physical operations, so the experience holds together end to end.

## How he works

1. Reading the ground. Field-level fluency in operations: boutique hotels, F&B, design partners, open-data ecosystems. He learns an environment before he designs for it.
2. From insight to product decisions. Aetherix is the proof: a real operating layer for boutique hotels, not a slideware concept.
3. Right tool for the problem. Sometimes a workflow, sometimes a checklist, sometimes an agentic system. The lightest mechanism that solves the job, with the human in the loop.

## Aetherix

URL: https://ivandemurard.com/aetherix. Repository: https://github.com/IvandeMurard/Hospitality-Operations-Agentic-AI-B2B/tree/main.

Aetherix is an agentic AI framework for boutique hotel operations. It anticipates staffing and F&B needs in real time, reduces food waste and operational costs, and frees teams to focus on exceptional guest experiences.

Architecture: Internal context (Apaleo PMS via OAuth and MCP read) combines with external signals (weather, events, social sentiment) to feed a FastAPI backend. Intelligence layers combine Prophet for numerical forecasting, Qdrant and pgvector for semantic memory, Claude Sonnet for cognitive reasoning, and an outbound MCP server for action. Delivery channels include WhatsApp push and Next.js verification dashboards. Current status: live Apaleo OAuth and MCP read access.

Design partners include Toni Stoeckl and Avi Brosh.

## Sonor

URL: https://ivandemurard.com/sonor. Two-year journey (2020 to 2022) as Co-founder & Product Lead. Turned open data into a B2G SaaS used by municipalities to protect acoustic health, drive sustainability policies, and increase territorial attractiveness. Backed by Matrice and Banque des Territoires, 20K EUR in grants, MVP shipped.

## Tacet

URL: https://ivandemurard.com/tacet. Tacet is the Synthetic Acoustic Twin: a proactive, headless intelligence layer for hospitality (B2B, 2026). It began as a Bruitparif-powered Score Sérénité dashboard for Parisians, then pivoted to a physics-based, software-only acoustic model of the hotel. It ingests proxy APIs (OpenData construction permits, traffic flow, weather, local events), uses OpenStreetMap 3D geometry to compute acoustic line of sight and building shielding, and pushes JSON alerts to the hotel's Revenue Management System and Property Management System. Designed to work in tandem with Aetherix: Aetherix reads internal context (occupancy, F&B, staffing), Tacet reads external context (street, weather, events). Together they form one predictive digital twin. Five-year goal: establish the Quiet Certification standard for the industry, integrated by major aggregators (Booking.com, Airbnb).

## Track record

- 2024 to 2025, Product Manager, SaaS, FORTIL for DomusVi. Rolled out an internal SaaS to 500+ users across 100 care homes. Led the full lifecycle from discovery and POC (Airtable, Make) to specs, IT mapping and field training.
- 2023 to 2024, Product Manager, Data & Operations, ALTEN for Bouygues Telecom. Built a data-driven dashboard to track and recover 1.9M EUR of receivables. 40% recovered, adopted by ops teams.
- 2022 to 2023, Customer Success Manager, Public Sector SaaS, Opendatasoft. Owned 22 European city and metropolitan clients from onboarding to production. 2 launches, zero churn.
- 2020 to 2022, Co-founder & Product Manager, Sonor. 0 to 1 B2G SaaS for urban noise mapping, backed by Matrice and Banque des Territoires.
